stylizer_modes.name: Standard (Identity & Outfit Lock)
stylizer_modes.description: Preserves exact facial geometry, skin tone, hairstyle, glasses, and original clothing while converting lighting and linework into cel-shaded Vice City ink art.

stylizer_modes.name: Detailed (Full Leonida Makeover)
stylizer_modes.description: Keeps facial likeness recognizable while upgrading wardrobe, accessories, tropical rim lighting, and Vice City vehicles to full key-art intensity.

photo_presets.name: Loading Screen
photo_presets.summary: Classic hand-painted GTA loading-screen portrait with bold ink outlines, cel shading, and a pink-purple Leonida sunset.
photo_presets.prompt_template: Stylized Vice City cel-shaded loading-screen illustration with crisp hand-inked contours and warm graphic novel shading. Subject leaning casually beside a vintage pastel-coral convertible parked along an Ocean Drive palm promenade, dramatic purple-to-flamingo-pink-to-golden Leonida sunset sky, warm golden rim light across cheekbones and shoulders. Preserve exact facial identity and expression. Clean full-bleed artwork, no text, no logos, no watermarks.

photo_presets.name: Vice City Neon
photo_presets.summary: Night-time Ocean Drive boulevard drenched in hot magenta and electric cyan neon reflections on wet asphalt.
photo_presets.prompt_template: Stylized Vice City cel-shaded key-art portrait on a rain-slicked midnight Ocean Drive boulevard, glowing hot-magenta and electric-cyan Art Deco hotel neon signs reflecting vividly on wet asphalt puddles, sleek exotic sports car headlights in soft background bokeh, dual cyan-and-pink neon rim lighting on the subject. Preserve exact facial identity. Clean full-bleed artwork, no text, no logos, no watermarks.

photo_presets.name: Cover Art
photo_presets.summary: Multi-panel comic box-cover framing with bold black diagonal borders, helicopter searchlight, speedboats, and palm silhouettes.
photo_presets.prompt_template: Multi-panel Vice City comic-poster cover composition divided by bold black diagonal borders: central hero portrait of the subject in the main foreground panel, surrounded by dynamic coastal panels showing palm silhouettes, a helicopter searchlight at dusk, a speedboat cutting turquoise waves, and pastel Art Deco hotels. Preserve exact facial likeness. Clean full-bleed poster, no title text, no logos, no watermarks.

photo_presets.name: Couple Cover
photo_presets.summary: Two-person Lucia & Jason inspired duo poster leaning against a classic muscle car under purple-pink coastal palms.
photo_presets.prompt_template: Two-person romantic crime-drama duo portrait inspired by tropical Vice City cover art: both subjects leaning together against the hood of a vintage American muscle car under swaying palm trees and a vivid pink-purple-amber coastal sunset. Keep each person's distinct facial identity, hairstyle, and skin tone 100% separate and recognizable without merging features. Clean full-bleed artwork, no text, no logos, no watermarks.

photo_presets.name: 5-Star Wanted
photo_presets.summary: High-adrenaline pursuit key art with red-and-blue police cruiser strobes, drifting tire smoke, and low-angle framing.
photo_presets.prompt_template: High-adrenaline low-angle Vice City pursuit key-art composition: flashing red-and-blue police cruiser lightbars and drifting pursuit cars with dynamic comic motion streaks behind the subject, dramatic red-blue rim strobes, drifting tire smoke, five small glowing white star icons cleanly in the top-right HUD corner only. Preserve exact facial identity. No brand logos, no title text, no watermarks.

photo_presets.name: In-Game Selfie
photo_presets.summary: Vice City luxury penthouse balcony selfie complete with circular mini-map radar HUD and crisp cel-shaded contours.
photo_presets.prompt_template: Stylized front-camera smartphone selfie perspective on a luxury ocean-view Vice City penthouse balcony at sunset, featuring a clean diegetic open-world game HUD overlay with a circular pastel street mini-map radar and pink/green health-armor bar in the bottom-left corner. Preserve exact facial identity. No brand title logos, no watermarks.

photo_presets.name: Vice City Crew
photo_presets.summary: Assemble up to 4 friends into one panoramic heist crew loading screen in front of custom rides at dusk.
photo_presets.prompt_template: Panoramic squad loading-screen illustration: assemble all subjects from the reference photo(s) standing shoulder-to-shoulder as an iconic Vice City heist crew in front of customized muscle cars and sports rides under purple-gold dusk palm skies, preserving every individual's distinct facial identity and hairstyle. Clean full-bleed artwork, no text, no logos, no watermarks.

photo_presets.name: Wanted Mugshot
photo_presets.summary: Leonida County booking portrait in front of a height chart holding a numeric slate in crisp cel-shaded ink.
photo_presets.prompt_template: Front-facing booking portrait inside a gritty coastal sheriff station standing in front of a horizontal black-and-white height measurement wall chart (5'0" to 6'6"), harsh overhead flash lighting, cel-shaded ink lines, subject holding a dark booking slate with numeric code 'VC-0626' only. Preserve exact facial identity. No brand logos, no watermarks.

photo_presets.name: Jet Ski Chase
photo_presets.summary: Full-throttle bay watercraft run with ocean spray, chopper spotlight, and a glowing Vice City twilight skyline.
photo_presets.prompt_template: Dynamic three-quarter action shot carving across glowing twilight bay waters on a high-powered watercraft, crystalline ocean spray splashing in foreground, helicopter spotlight beam sweeping across purple-orange sunset clouds and the glowing Vice City skyline behind. Preserve exact facial identity. Clean full-bleed artwork, no text, no logos, no watermarks.
